html:
You’ve chosen the perfect window tint or paint protection for your car, but have you considered who’s applying it? Even the most advanced tint films or protective coatings can underperform if not installed correctly. While product specs often take centre stage, it’s the unseen craftsmanship of professional application that determines whether your investment looks great, lasts long, and performs as promised.

Tint a Car have spent over 50 years perfecting the art of automotive and architectural tint and surface protection. Backed by ARPANSA-certified films, nationwide warranties, and exclusive technologies like graphene-infused coatings and hybrid matrix films, our installations are carried out by trained professionals who understand how precision drives performance.

dle

Why Bundling Is a Smarter Choice

Booking one service at a time, tint now, coating later, interior protection someday, can feel like an endless cycle. Bundling solves that by protecting every surface in a single visit, saving you time, hassle, and coordination stress.

When you choose a window tint and paint protection bundle from Tint a Car, every product is applied in harmony by trained professionals. No scheduling gaps, no risk of incompatible treatments, and no half-measures.

Whether you choose the darkest legal tint like Octane, heat-deflecting Spectre, or hybrid-tech Black Panther, your selected film pairs seamlessly with Elite X +Graphene Ceramic Coating and Interior Surface Protection.

Need even more coverage? Paint Protection Film (PPF) adds an extra layer on high-impact areas like bonnets and bumpers.

Benefits of bundling products include:

  • One coordinated service, less disruption
  • Reduced downtime and scheduling fatigue
  • Customisable for new or used vehicles
  • Nationwide warranty across all inclusions

Get More for Less with a Ceramic Bundle Deal

Bundling services into a ceramic bundle deal gives you access to promotional pricing that individual services simply can’t match.

You can benefit from zero-interest finance options, including Afterpay and ZIP Pay, making it easier to protect your vehicle now and pay later.

With bundled protection in place, you’ll save on long-term maintenance too. Paint protected by Elite X stays cleaner and resists wear, interior surfaces repel stains and fading, and quality tint keeps your cabin cool while reducing UV exposure.

Not sure what suits your vehicle? Packages are tailored to your car’s type and your protection goals. Pricing varies depending on film selection and coverage, so request a quote from your local Tint a Car store to see your best-fit bundle.

Protection That Lasts with Less Effort

One of the biggest benefits of bundling? You don’t need to work as hard to keep your car looking its best.

Elite X +Graphene Infused Surface Protection features a nanotech hydrophobic surface that causes water to bead and roll off, taking dirt with it. No waxing required. No hours spent scrubbing grime off the bonnet.

Interior protection means spills don’t soak in. UV-blocking tints reduce dash cracking and seat fading. And with PPF in place, you’re far less likely to need repainting or touch-ups on exposed surfaces.

The result is a cleaner, glossier vehicle with less maintenance and more time for driving.

Why Drivers Trust Tint a Car

When it comes to protecting your car, credentials matter. With over 50 years in the industry, Tint a Car is Australia’s most recognised name in automotive tinting and surface protection.

All tint films are ARPANSA certified for UV protection. Every coating and film is professionally applied and backed by a national warranty. And our team of trained technicians ensures consistent quality across all locations.

You’re not just choosing products. You’re choosing peace of mind from a brand that stands behind its work.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is this just for new cars? Not at all. As long as your car has been recently cleaned or detailed, it can benefit from bundling, especially if you want to restore or maintain a near-new appearance.

Can I just get the tint? Yes. All services are available separately. But bundling gives you better pricing and superior synergy between products.

Will it void my warranty? No. All products are safe for factory paint and interiors. They won’t affect your manufacturer warranty.

Does it really last? Yes. Elite X offers a lifetime warranty, and PPF is backed by a 10-year guarantee. These aren’t short-term solutions, they’re built to last.

Get a Quote Today

The smarter way to protect your car is to treat it as a whole. With bundled tints, coatings, and interior care, you get a consistent result, superior durability, and far less upkeep. It’s more value, more protection, and more peace of mind, all in one package.
